items.title: Wizard Academia Pack 2
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
We're here with part 2, and another 50 skins! The wizard teens are back again, this time even trendier than before. Together they enhance their magical skills, while looking their mystical best. Role play in your own personalized wizard in training skin.

- Includes 2 free skins
- Created by RedStudios, partnered with G2Crafted

items.title: Ninjas!
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
They might look cute and fluffy, but these sneaky animals are talented warriors!

- 12 skins
- Cool ninja styling
- Choose your favorite animal!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Ultimate Spring Break
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
The ultimate Spring break skin pack is here! There are bees, flowers, and teens in this skin pack to celebrate the coming of Spring.

- 24 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Medieval Castle
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Are you ready to explore the past?
Wander around this city that has been left a long time ago. Discover the hidden message in the books and try to unravel the myths behind this Minecraft world. Are you brave enough to accept this adventure?

+ Challenging dungeons
+ Decrypt the hidden code!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Collab Pack 1
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Be ready to go skyblock, adventure or just explore?
Take out your favorite skin and go!

This collection has a special look for everybody!

+ 1 free girl.
+ 1 free boy.
+ 10 epic skins!

items.title: Skyblock Chunks
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A chunky Skyblock adventure! Search for items on every island to create an End Portal and defeat the Ender Dragon! 

- Multiplayer friendly
- Various Skyblock islands
- By RareLoot

items.title: Flying Island
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
An all-powerful warrior people living secluded in the ranges of the thick vegetation of the tropical rainforest have left behind their mighty fortress for you to explore. Do you dare to enter or are you afraid of the many potential hidden traps?

- Fly around and be free!
- Elytras
- By RareLoot

items.title: World's Safest Mansion
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Scared of having your house blown up in the middle of the night, unable to rest assured that you are safe from the dangers outside? No need to worry anymore! No mob can stand up to the defences of this villa, allowing you to live in peace!

- Extremely safe villa
- A lot of of hidden chests
- Perfect base for a survival adventure
- Furnished in detail
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Elite Of Mobs
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Show everyone that you are the cream of the crop and the most elite mob of them all! Give your coolness the boost it needs with these cool and top-notch skins!

- 10 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Element Pirates
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Control the elements and seize incredible riches and loot as an element pirate braving the wild seas. Show your friends how powerful you are with these cool skins with a surprising twist!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Anime Illagers
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Become the villain you have always wanted to be! Become the most despicable Illager, tormenting the villagers and your friends with these anime inspired skins!

- 10 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Freedom Outlanders
items.creator: Dark Lab Creations
items.description:
These outlanders are ready for any adventure you can think of! 
* 22 HD skins!

items.title: Dreams & Nightmares
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Some nights you have dreams so sweet that you forget it the moment you wake up. Other nights you have nightmares that stick in your mind for years to come. It's time to go to sleep to see what's in store for you!

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Cute and modern attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Devil Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Devils can be nice some times too! We're not all that bad. We like to be happy and hate being sad as well! You think you be friends with a devil teen?

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern, luxury attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Akatsuki
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
The Akatsuki clan is an ancient clan hidden the shadows of society. They have but one purpose: to obtain and monopolize power. Do you have what it takes to join our clan?

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Fantasy, shinobi attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Devilish Teens
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Some teens be looking spicy! Like devilish levels of spicy. So handsome and so cool! 

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Modern attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Millionaire Mansion Vacation
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Welcome to your own private vacation home away from home! This mansion is ready for you to explore and enjoy! Come on in!

+ Huge mansion!
+ Lots of indoor amenities!

items.title: Millionaire Getaway
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Welcome home to your new millionaire getaway! Take your time to enjoy the new amenities in the mansion! Make it your own!

+ Huge modern mansion!
+ Beachside view!
+ Golf course!

items.title: Mediera
items.creator: Diluvian
items.description:
A long time ago, the hero destroyed the Ice evil lord and became a legend. Now, centuries after this great history, you are in the mediera kingdom ready to explore it's secrets, mines, castles, farms and dozens of unique places to explore!

+ 800x800 deitailed map with lots of place to explore! 
+ Several castles!
+ Multiple houses for you to live in!

items.title: Lost Pandas
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Lost Pandas formed a rescue group. They are out on the streets to rescue every lost creature and get them back home.

- 21 cool panda skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Secret Ninjas
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Stealth, power, and a dedication to the ancient arts have brought you here. You are the reason others fear the dark, for those who became nothing more than an additional scratch on your sheath. No doubt, your soulless eyes would become a legend, but a legend must first be seen.

items.title: Battle Ready
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Your body is hardened by the act of battle. The power wielded by your hands is more than strength, it is an ancient art perfected over a millennia. Wield these skills in honor against any challenger who chooses to stand in your path.

items.title: Particles
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Become a floating aura of particles where every step you take is like hundreds of flecks dancing in the breeze. Finally, you can now drift in and out of environments in style.

items.title: Star Block
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description: Own your own galaxy! Star Block is a huge open-world space survival spawn with complete-the-monument challenges. As a member of the Big Space Explorer team, discover the location of hidden beacons throughout 40+ systems. Work alone or with friends to uncover secret co-ordinates, travel to alien worlds, and establish far-flung bases to operate from. See you in space!
